purpose: Explanatory voiceover added in post-production to the reviewed product walkthrough; separate from the unchanged continuous playback evidence.

segments.text: Meet Read Assist. Your library for documents, pictures, and web articles.
Swipe right to left to turn forward. Switch between PDF and text.
Swipe up for reading controls. Adjust the brightness and add a warm tint to suit your reading.
Choose your voice, reading speed, and accuracy settings.
Look up English words as you go. Download the dictionary pack once to use definitions offline.
Choose a style you like: Warm Library, Modern Focus, or Night Reader.
Night Reader brings a darker look to your library. Change themes whenever you like.
Start narration, then switch apps. Reading continues in the background, with playback controls close by.
When you are ready for a break, pause from Android media controls.

originalAppAudioWindow.note: Preserve two complete sentences of genuine recorded app speech; mute the original track outside this window in the narrated edition to avoid competing speech.

captions.text: Each sentence adds something new to the picture.
Listen to the words, or let your eyes move gently across the page.
